Completed a total of 106 on-site audits, including 39 third-party audits. Made signifi-
cant progress on closing priority and major findings.
Achieved our tantalum goal. Continued to take actions toward our 2013 goal.
Saw improvements in the percentage of our top Tier 1 suppliers that have environmental 
metrics. Made a formal request to our top 75 suppliers to prepare GRI-based sustainability 
reports and provided training sessions on getting started with reporting.
Reduced packaging weight by 10% from 2011 levels. While we successfully imple-
mented the planned reduction projects, we did not meet our goal due to a drop in the 
volume of products shipped from 2011 to 2012.
Continued to make progress toward our 2016 goal, achieving 65% by end of 2012.
